title: CombatGaurd
description: Punishes players who disconnect during combat! Log out while fighting and you'll be slain!
body:
# CombatGuard

A lightweight plugin that punishes players who disconnect during PvP combat!

## Features
- Automatically tags players when they enter PvP combat
- 15 second combat timer
- Players who disconnect while in combat are automatically slain
- Broadcasts a message to the server when someone combat logs
- Warning message so players know they are in combat

## How it works
1. Player A hits Player B
2. Both players are tagged as "in combat" for 15 seconds
3. If either player disconnects during those 15 seconds they die
4. If no combat happens for 15 seconds the tag is removed

## Compatibility
- Paper 26.1.2+
- Java 25+
